title: Understanding Localization in MapleStory Worlds
author: MapleStory Worlds Creator Center
summary: An official hands-on lesson for LocaleDataSet, LocalizationService, text keys, client language behavior, translators, and localized image or resource selection.

sections.title: Localization model
items: Use locale-aware keys instead of hard-coded player-facing strings.
LocaleDataSet stores source and localized values for each supported language.

sections.title: Runtime text
items: LocalizationService resolves text for the current client locale.
Translator instances can request text for a specific locale.

sections.title: Localized resources
items: Resource identifiers can be selected through localized data as well as text.
Test multiple client languages before publishing.

notes: Original MPStorys structured lesson verified against the official document on 2026-07-27.
steps: Replace visible strings with localization keys.
Test text and resources in every supported locale.
